department: Department of Earth and Planetary Sciences (D-EAPS)

deadline.value: No deadline: professors recruit doctoral students throughout the year, so apply whenever a position is open.
deadline.quote: There are no deadlines for submitting the registration for the doctorate, as the professors recruit their candidates throughout the year.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the official pages checked.

supervisor.value: You need a faculty member's written agreement to supervise your thesis before the admission procedure can start.
supervisor.quote: To initiate the admission procedure, the candidate must have obtained the written agreement of a faculty member to supervise the thesis.

funding.value: As a rule, doctoral students are employed as research assistants; the supervisor's institute draws up the contract.
funding.quote: As a rule, doctoral students are employed as research assistants.

entry_route.value: A completed university Master's degree is required before you can register for the doctorate.
entry_route.quote: You must have a university Master's degree.

notes: Provisional admission first; definite admission after the aptitude colloquium within the first year. Allow time for a visa.
